closeout.title: Raisa synthetic-first public-evidence scenario programme orientation
authority_notes: Yuri requested public research and research-directed workers, preferred synthetic-first development, and later identified a dense timestamped historical Diary archive as a possible carefully de-identified calibration source.
GPT Sol owns source-authority reconciliation, privacy interpretation, architecture selection, Git and acceptance.
Native workers completed seven read-only packages; DeepSeek received no package, Gemini was not called, and no provider or private data opened.

decisions.summary: Classify every influence before use and forbid vendor, fiction, model output and private observations from becoming authoritative outcome oracles.
Add one traceability envelope and legacy bindings rather than a third scenario engine.
Keep the historical archive unopened and require a later local-only privacy feasibility gate before any real snapshot access.

claim_scope: Seven read-only research packages and twenty registered public sources support one traceable synthetic scenario programme boundary.
Existing semantic and replay contracts can be bound without content duplication.
Dense timestamped snapshots make interval-censored workflow reconstruction plausible but do not establish exact event time or irreversible anonymity.
No private data, provider call, product change or protected surface opened.
unresolved_gates: The historical Diary archive remains unopened; any real snapshot access requires a separate accepted local-only privacy feasibility gate.
Provider-live synthetic evaluation requires its own exact data, call, cost, effect and proofreader envelope.
Product, ordinary-practice activation, production, deployment, Pages and protected refs remain closed.

journey.strategic_role: Give Raisa a traceable synthetic practice laboratory spanning administrative and clinical-diagnostic architecture.
journey.outcome: Public sources and existing EMR4 contracts now converge on one small reusable envelope boundary.

current_position.strategic_role: Build source and oracle traceability before scaling scenario generation or calibrating from private observations.
current_position.why_now: The research streams are complete and the existing semantic and replay engines need a shared provenance layer.
current_position.outcome: The next tranche can implement one strict envelope and two exact legacy bindings.
unlocks: Traceable expansion across reception, administrative and later clinical-diagnostic scenario families.
A clean future interface for privacy-reviewed aggregate calibration without resolving private data.
does_not_solve: It does not prove real-world efficacy, de-identify the historical archive or open provider/product runtime.
current_position.orientation_statement: Bind provenance, authority and oracles before increasing scenario volume or realism.

next_operation.active_tranche: Raisa traceable synthetic scenario envelope and legacy binding rehearsal
next_operation.objective: Implement one strict domain-neutral traceability envelope and bind it to the two existing non-protected reception semantic and replay fixture pairs without duplicating either engine.
next_operation.authority_source: The accepted synthetic-first programme orientation and Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority.
